description: A single full-bleed square dark-fantasy release poster background for a D&D style game. One continuous near-black stone and blackened-iron field. A single worn-gold dragon-forged ornamental border runs along the four outer edges only, with restrained corner ornaments, tiny crimson gems and a faint cold violet ember glow. The entire interior inside that border is one flat, dark, calm, uninterrupted surface: no inner panels, cards, boxes, sub-frames, dividers, ornaments, dragon heads, gems, seams, smoke, characters, weapons or bright highlights, because text will be placed over it later. No text, letters, numbers, runes, pseudo-text, glyphs, logo or watermark anywhere. Premium, elegant, epic, strict, restrained, not cluttered.
